ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

2. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.

5. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

6. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

7. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.

8. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.

9. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

10. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Inductors and inductance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity 3.2 Equipment at the Co and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Equipment at the Consumers Intake Point 3.3 Final Circuits 4.0 Electronics 4.1 S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — CPU

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.

3. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.

11. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. A — Information and Communication Technology

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Inductors and inductance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity 3.2 Equipment at the Co; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Equipment at the Consumers Intake Point 3.3 Final Circuits 4.0 Electronics 4.1 S; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
